dismantling_text: Browse donor cars and ask about available parts from a specific vehicle.
cars-for-sale_text: Explore cars for purchase and contact us to arrange a viewing.

request_intro: Describe the part you need. Add vehicle details, an OEM number, and photos if available.
photo_help: Up to 6 JPEG, PNG, or WebP photos, 4 MB each. Photos are private and visible only to our staff.
consent: I have read the privacy information and understand that my details and photos will be used to handle this inquiry.

viber_help: For Viber, copy the request text, open the chat, and paste it. Attach photos in the app or use our private website form.
manual_confirmation: Requests and rental bookings are confirmed only after our reply.
